task.name: pick_cube_transfer_place_basket_ep1
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the blue cube, transfer it to the left arm and then use the left arm to put it in the basket.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the blue cube.
2. Grasp the blue cube with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to a transfer position.
4. Move the left arm to the transfer position to receive the blue cube.
5. Transfer the blue cube from the right arm to the left arm.
6. Move the left arm to align with the basket.
7. Release the gripper to place the blue cube into the basket.
